title: HotelSeoSchema
description: Single Source of Truth JSON Schema for Hotel Property SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) Signals, and Template Payloads.

PropertyAudit.description: Core on-page and technical hospitality audit data for a single inspected property.

url.description: Fully qualified target URL of the inspected hotel page.

brand.description: Hospitality parent brand or franchise flag (e.g. Marriott, Hilton, IHG, Hyatt, Independent).

neighborhood.description: Micro-neighborhood, district, or geographic demand generator anchor.

wordCount.description: Total body prose word count excluding boilerplate navigation.

GeoSignals.description: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI search visibility signals.

hasHotelSchema.description: Whether valid Schema.org/Hotel or LodgingBusiness JSON-LD is detected.

hasFaqSchema.description: Whether valid Schema.org/FAQPage JSON-LD is detected.

entityDensityScore.description: Normalized score (0-100) reflecting factual and entity density in prose.

citationReadinessScore.description: Normalized score (0-100) evaluating citation likelihood in Gemini, Perplexity, and ChatGPT Search.

missingEntities.description: List of recognized local or brand entities missing from the page copy.

TemplatePayload.description: Payload for template rendering and variable substitution.

templateId.description: Identifier of the SEO Studio template being executed.

variables.description: Key-value dictionary of string variables resolved into template placeholders.

renderedOutput.description: Fully resolved template content ready for deployment or export.

validationWarnings.description: Deterministic warnings raised during validation or variable replacement.
